correctness.rationale: The proof constructs an impossible labeling for every forbidden support motif, and a label-dependent completion for every other motif by the one-double and two-hole bridge lemmas. An independent standard-library checker exhausts every support through n=15 and verifies the complete coefficient sequence, 16 bridging boundary cases, and fixed-background extrema through n=10.

value.rationale: The claim specifies a natural constrained-word concept class with an infinite antichain of minimal forbidden support substrings but a compact rational coefficientwise shattering enumerator. It determines every support count and the sharp length-dependent VC dimension; comparing it with a different quantifier convention gives a linear separation from fixed-background free-site density. The classification is structural and motivates the precise invariants, not just a small census or a standard counting exercise.
